recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native portrait mobile game called `World Circuit Rivals`. It is a roster-based side-view arcade fighting simulator inspired by global versus fighting tournaments. The player drafts Blue Corner and Red Corner fighters using touch-friendly plus/minus roster cards under a 15-unit cap, sets a stamina scale, then rings the bell. Fighters are AI-controlled archetypes with readable movement, blocks, melee, projectiles, summons, stun, invulnerability, super-arena/domain effects, and dramatic special move callouts. The game uses a procedural canvas world-finals stage with crowd lights, city banners, corner vitality bars, glove/sash fighter silhouettes, strike particles, and bold arcade typography. Preserve the underlying mechanics: team cap, stamina multipliers, auto-battle loop, damage/block/cooldown behavior, aggregate HP bars, pause/menu/restart, and win/draw by surviving non-summon units.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game Truth
- genre: mobile portrait roster-based side-view auto-battle / arena fighting simulator
- objective: draft blue and red teams, ring the bell, and watch the selected corner eliminate all opposing non-summon fighters.
- input model: tap/click roster plus/minus buttons, stamina range slider, start, info, audio, pause, menu, resume, and restart controls.
- core loop: choose rosters under a 15-unit cap, apply HP multiplier, spawn teams on opposite sides of a canvas, run AI movement and specials, update aggregate vitality, show result, allow runback or menu.
- fail/friction state: one corner loses when all of its non-summon fighters reach zero HP; draw if both corners are eliminated together. Pause and menu interrupt active play.

## Protected Mechanics
- 15-unit cap per team, default one anchor per side, stamina multiplier values, AI-driven pursuit, gravity/floor bounds, melee range, projectile collision, block chance/cooldown, stun/invulnerability, summons, super arena/domain timing, aggregate HP bars, and win/draw conditions.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD labels, title, roster names/descriptions/icons, CSS layout, canvas drawing style, background, particle colors/forms, popup vocabulary, audio tone labels, font choices, and result copy can be transformed safely.

## Remix Blueprint
Rebuild the same protected loop as `World Circuit Rivals`: a Street-Fighter-inspired global tournament auto-battle where Blue Corner and Red Corner draft expressive archetypes, trigger readable specials, and resolve a dramatic portrait-first arcade duel on a procedural world finals stage.
